title: Eaterior Object State v1.8.0
description: Live state of any plan object (component): active/passive, how far it is open, device power. Kept outside the plan like table state; objectId refers to an id in the plan. Values here override the plan's defaults.

format.description: "eaterior-object-state" is the identifier written since 1.8.0. "eateryplan-object-state" is the pre-1.8 name of the same format and stays accepted when reading.

extensions.description: Application-specific or forward-compatible data. Keys must be namespaced (e.g. 'acme.priceTier'). Clients ignore unknown keys and preserve them on save.

source.description: System that produced this document, e.g. 'pos' or 'bms'.

active.description: false = passive: closed, out of service or disabled.

open.description: 0 = closed, 1 = fully open. Pergola louvers / retractable roofs, folding and sliding glass walls, doors and windows.

power.description: Climate devices and appliance fixtures (stove, oven, coffee machine, dishwasher, fridge, freezer, display case, TV, POS terminal).

mode.description: Free-form device mode, e.g. cooling, heating, fan.

extensions.description: Application-specific or forward-compatible data. Keys must be namespaced (e.g. 'acme.priceTier'). Clients ignore unknown keys and preserve them on save.

externalRef.description: Identify the object by its id in an external system instead of objectId.

level.description: Intensity 0–1 where it applies: heat level, fan speed, burner flame. Renderers scale effects with it.

externalRef.description: A record in an external system (POS, reservations, BMS/IoT, inventory …) that this object corresponds to.

id.description: The record's id in that system.

type.description: Optional record type in that system (table, area, device …).
